mapper.select: select count(cno) from tbl_cart where cno > 0 and uno = #{uno}

select p.ptitle_ko, p.ptitle_en, p.ptitle_ja, p.ptitle_zh, cu.cqty from tbl_product p left join ( select c.cno, c.pno, c.cqty, c.cregdate from tbl_cart c left join tbl_user u on c.uno = u.uno where u.uno = #{uno} ) cu on p.pno = cu.pno where cu.cno > 0 order by cu.cregdate desc limit #{pageRequest.skip}, #{pageRequest.size}
